properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for non-centrally managed account management
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to validate that accounts which cannot be centrally managed, such as local accounts on virtual machines, are: (1) managed through a Caelum approved privileged access management solution. (2) disabled by default where possible. (3) Identified and their use is monitored and audited to ensure that these credentials are secured as described in SCF-IAM-04 Secure Secret Management.
